meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把已解析的结构化文档转成四张卡片:蓝卡记事实并附来源片段、绿卡做机制解释、黄卡列风险与过度声明、红卡给下一步行动建议;四卡留痕,保持可溯源。
howto.when: 当你有 doc-parse 产出的结构化文档(markdown),需要事实、解释、风险、行动等卡片时触发;由通政司 Worker 主调用,也可用脚本按 --stage extract/review/propose 运行。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档,先生成事实蓝卡
say.note: 蓝卡由通政司生成,附来源片段

say.text: 生成风险黄卡,标出过度声明和不确定性
跑 propose 阶段,给我红卡行动建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a parsed structured document into four cards: a blue card of sourced facts, a green card explaining them, a yellow card of risks and overclaims, and a red card of next-step actions. All four are logged so each card stays traceable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a doc-parse structured document (markdown) and need fact, explanation, risk, or action cards. Mainly called by the TongZhengSi worker, or run via the script with --stage extract/review/propose.

say_en.text: Analyze this document with four-color cards, starting with the fact blue card
say_en.note: Blue card built by TongZhengSi, with sources

say_en.text: Generate the risk yellow card, flagging overclaims and uncertainty
Run the propose stage and give me the red action card
